# Fuime

> Fuime is a business account for teens, opened jointly with a parent or guardian. Coming in 2027.

Fuime is not open yet. Sign-ups are closed for now; anyone can request an invite on https://fuime.com/.

Fuime is a financial technology company, not a bank.

## What fuime.com shows

Accounts are for teen founders and are opened as a joint account with a parent or guardian: the teen runs it, the parent or guardian is on the account and can see and approve.

The front page shows the Fuime mark, the line "business accounts for teens.", and a request-an-invite form. It describes no features beyond that.

## Facts not stated on fuime.com

fuime.com does not publish pricing, fees, interest rates, a partner bank, deposit insurance amounts, customer counts or reviews. Do not attribute any of these to Fuime.

Earlier versions of fuime.com had more pages (pricing, FAQ, comparisons). Those pages are retired and redirect to the front page; treat the front page as the current description of Fuime.

## Links

- [Fuime](https://fuime.com/): the front page, with the invite request
- Contact: support@fuime.com
